settings.title: Lifecycle Stage Groups
settings.description: The stages each entity type moves through and the moves allowed between them. Every stage belongs to a category, which drives publishing, the Marketplace and the ODCS / ODPS export.
settings.deleteDescription: “{{name}}” and its stages will be deleted. A group still assigned to entities can’t be deleted.

errors.lifecycle_action_ambiguous: Several stages of the {{category}} category can follow {{fromStatus}} ({{candidates}}). Change the status to one of them instead.
errors.lifecycle_group_not_found: The lifecycle stage group doesn’t exist.
errors.lifecycle_group_wrong_entity_type: This lifecycle stage group is for another entity type.
errors.lifecycle_change_same_group: It already follows this lifecycle; change its status instead.
errors.lifecycle_change_pending_request: The lifecycle can’t change while a workflow request is pending for it.
errors.lifecycle_stage_invalid_key: Stage key “{{key}}” must use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.
errors.lifecycle_transition_unknown_stage: The move {{fromKey}} → {{toKey}} names a stage the group doesn’t have.
errors.lifecycle_group_initial_stage_one: A group needs exactly one first stage; it has {{count}}.
errors.lifecycle_group_initial_stage_other: A group needs exactly one first stage; it has {{count}}.
errors.lifecycle_group_initial_not_draft: The first stage “{{key}}” must be in the Draft category, so a lifecycle change can’t skip review.
errors.lifecycle_group_unreachable_stages: These stages can’t be reached from the first stage: {{stages}}.
errors.lifecycle_group_no_active_stage: A group needs at least one stage in the Active category.
errors.lifecycle_stage_in_use_one: Stage “{{key}}” can’t be removed: {{count}} entity is in it.
errors.lifecycle_stage_in_use_other: Stage “{{key}}” can’t be removed: {{count}} entities are in it.
errors.lifecycle_stage_in_workflow: Stage “{{key}}” can’t be removed: workflows use it ({{workflows}}).
errors.lifecycle_group_name_taken: A lifecycle named “{{name}}” already exists for this entity type.
errors.lifecycle_group_entity_type_immutable: A group’s entity type can’t change.
errors.lifecycle_group_default_required: Every entity type needs a default lifecycle: make another group the default instead.
errors.lifecycle_group_is_default: The default lifecycle of an entity type can’t be deleted.
errors.lifecycle_group_in_use_one: This lifecycle is used by {{count}} entity and can’t be deleted.
errors.lifecycle_group_in_use_other: This lifecycle is used by {{count}} entities and can’t be deleted.

defaultGroupDescription: Seeded lifecycle; reproduces the built-in transitions.

editor.description: Order the stages, pick each one’s category, and tick the moves allowed between them. The first stage must be a draft one.
editor.name: Name
editor.label: Label
editor.keyImmutable: Entities store the key; it can’t change once saved.
editor.matrixHint: A row is the current stage, a column the stage it may move to.
editor.graphLabel: Graph of the stages and allowed moves; moves back are dashed

picker.label: Lifecycle
picker.hint: The stages it moves through. Admins and owners can change it later; that resets the status to the first stage.

change.title: Change lifecycle
change.description: It follows “{{group}}” now. Pick the lifecycle stage group it should follow instead.
change.reset: The status resets to the first stage of the new lifecycle:
change.resetHint: No workflow gates run. A published entity is unpublished, and the change is written to the change log. It is refused while a workflow request is pending.

graph.title: Lifecycle: {{name}}
graph.hint: The current stage is outlined; moves back are dashed.
